source.name: Knight Frank figures reported by ETRealty

areas.name: South Bengaluru
areas.meaning: The largest market, but the longest reported sell-through period. Compare projects carefully and negotiate on inventory that has been available longer.

areas.name: East Bengaluru
areas.meaning: Strong activity with a shorter sell-through period than South. Project-level competition and delivery quality matter more than the city headline.

areas.name: North Bengaluru
areas.meaning: Reported sales rose 11% year-on-year and launches 10% year-on-year. Growth is strong, but infrastructure and project execution need checking.

areas.name: West Bengaluru
areas.meaning: The published corridor data is too thin to call this area hot or cold. Do not infer a trend from the low inventory number alone.

areas.name: Central Bengaluru
areas.meaning: Very little comparable public volume is reported. Treat city-wide research as a poor proxy for individual central-market decisions.
